name: com.ezg.ezgkit
description: One-window Unity Editor setup kit that walks a new project through its per-project configuration in the order it must happen. Ships two pages: Marketing (pull a Google Sheet of store/ads identifiers and write them into PlayerSettings, AdsConfig, AppLovinSettings, FacebookSettings, AndroidManifest and GameConstant.cs) and Firebase (pick a service-account .json, provision the Android + iOS apps, then download google-services.json / GoogleService-Info.plist). Opening the window only ever reads; every write sits behind an explicit button. Also ships the shared EzgKitStyles / SetupGui drawing toolkit and the IEzgKitPage contract so a project can add its own setup tab.
